title: 1Password launches a way for AI agents to log in on your behalf without seeing your password
slides: Can 1Password let AI agents log in without your password?
It debuts scoped credentials agents use on your behalf.
Agents never see the raw secret—only a time-limited token.
Your team can now delegate access without sharing passwords.
Audit every agent login before trust becomes default.
thread_text:
1. AI Agents Are Logging In

1Password just debuted scoped credentials, letting AI agents act on your behalf without ever seeing your password.

2. Token, Not Secret

Agents only receive a time-limited token. The raw password stays hidden from the agent.

3. Delegation Without Sharing

Your team can now grant access to agents without handing over passwords.

4. Audit Every Login

See exactly when and how agents log in. Review before trust becomes default.

5. Take Action Today

Check your password manager for similar features. If your team uses agents, demand scoped tokens now.

instagram.caption:
Your AI agent can now log in for you without ever holding your actual password.

1Password rolled out scoped credentials: agents get a time-limited token instead of the raw secret 🔑

The password stays hidden from the agent the entire time.

Your team can delegate access to agents without handing over a single password.

For anyone building or publishing with AI tools, this means agent logins can be audited and reviewed before you default to trusting them.

Would you let an agent log into your accounts if you could see every single login it makes? 👀
